summary: Created Redux Toolkit store with smsSlice for SMS message scheduling and delivery tracking. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux, defined JSDoc type definitions (MessageStatus enum, Message/SmsState interfaces), implemented smsSlice with reducers (addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, setError) and selectors (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus), configured the Redux store, and wrapped the app with the Redux Provider.
